## AgentForge Guard

This repository is governed by `agentforge.yaml` (policy `polyglot`). These instructions are for AGENT; the policy, not this text, is what is enforced.

- Run scripts, generated shell code and anything untrusted through afg: `afg run -- <command>`. afg routes them to an isolated container.
- Check a command first with `afg policy explain -- <command>`. Do not try to work around a denial; ask the user instead.
- Never read or print credential files (`.env`, `.env.*`, `*.pem`, `*.key`, `*.p12`, `*.pfx`, `~/.ssh`, `~/.aws`, `~/.kube`).
- Denied: `kubectl delete`, `kubectl drain`, `terraform destroy`, `helm uninstall`, `git push --force`, `git push -f`, `git push --force-with-lease`, `git push --delete`, `docker system prune`, `dropdb`.
- Needs human approval: `npm install`, `npm ci`, `pnpm install`, `pnpm add`, `yarn install`, `yarn add`, `bun install`, `pip install`, `pip3 install`, `cargo install`, `cargo add`, `go install`, `go get`, `kubectl apply`, `kubectl create`, `kubectl replace`, `kubectl patch`, `kubectl edit`, `kubectl scale`, `kubectl rollout`, `kubectl exec`, `terraform apply`, `terraform import`, `terraform state`, `helm install`, `helm upgrade`, `helm rollback`, `docker push`, `git push`, `git reset --hard`, `git clean`, `cargo publish`, `npm publish`, `pnpm publish`, `wrangler deploy`, `go mod download`, `cargo fetch`.
- Runs in a container: `bash`, `sh`, `zsh`, `python`, `python3`, `node`, `make`.
